title: Bose's paper published under Einstein's endorsement

tellings.quote: >> and he sent one to Albert Einstein said, "Nobody's listening to me."

plain: In the 1920s, the Indian physicist Satyendra Nath Bose is said to have sent a paper that no one would take up to Albert Einstein, telling him "Nobody's listening to me", and the paper was then published with Einstein's backing. Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor who appears on the show as a UFO witness, tells Michels this without naming a source, as an example of an ignored idea that got heard once the right person read it.
